observation: Three requests reached the 30-second benchmark timeout without a completed inference result; the phase was aborted. Ollama HTTP API remained reachable but listed no loaded models. Ollama was retrying a runner port after that runner had exited.
resolution: Added and hot-loaded exact user/process/loopback constraints for Ollama API and ephemeral runner ports, then restarted only the experiment-owned Ollama server. Successful rerun metrics are stored separately.
